milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the red glazed terracotta wall and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the target.' The terracotta is a 3×2 back wall of a stone brick structure at spawn-relative [5, 1, 4], visible through the open front face. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range (sandbox confirmed visibility from ~6-7 blocks), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking at the terracotta, not facing away.
